verdict.rationale: Live, around-the-clock customer support is a fair question for a payroll and banking SaaS like Gusto, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers support channels, hours, or live-agent availability. The pack only covers business formation, banking, the Money Dashboard, and developer tooling (MCP server, CLI, SDK, webhooks, OpenAPI).

support.subject: As a founder, I can reach live customer support at any time for urgent account issues
